glosses: Being in one of two mutually exclusive states.

examples.text: Binary states are often represented as 1 and 0 in computer science.

It's not binary. You can be decent and gifted at the same time.

glosses: Concerning logic whose subject matter concerns such states.

examples.text: Near-synonym: Boolean

glosses: Concerning numbers and calculations using the binary number system.

examples.text: binary star
Two ingredients are combined in a binary poison.
A binary statistical distribution has only two categories.

glosses: Of an operation, function, procedure, or logic gate, taking exactly two operands, arguments, parameters, or inputs; having domain of dimension 2.

examples.text: Division of reals is a binary operation.

glosses: Of data, consisting coded values (e.g. machine code) not interpretable as plain or ASCII text (e.g. source code).

examples.text: He downloaded the binary distribution for Linux, then burned it to DVD.

glosses: Focusing on two mutually exclusive conditions.

examples.text: He has a very binary understanding of gender.

glosses: Having or pertaining to a gender identity represented by the gender binary; either male or female.

examples.text: To further unpack trans and gender-diverse embodiment, requires one to unpack the depth of the discourse as it relates to both binary and non-binary people (Hofman, 2012). It necessitates deeper engagement as to the politics of passing, not passing, societal assimilation and non-assimilation.
